title: Final Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final force on the legs must be correctly calculated as 8080g N.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The use of energy conservation principles to relate mechanical energy before landing and work done during deceleration must be clearly shown.

title: Correct Variables
description: Important Criteria: The correct identification and use of variables such as mass, height, and deceleration distance must be evident.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should include consistent units throughout the calculations, particularly for force and energy.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the calculations, particularly in the force direction, will result in a deduction.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to include gravitational acceleration (g) in the final force calculation will lead to a deduction.
